versions.changelog:
- Added a README.md file to provide additional documentation for the project.
- No changes to existing functionality; this release focuses on improved documentation.

Initial release of kisa-guideline-hub.

- Automates collection of security guidelines from KISA and Boho (KRCERT, 보호나라).
- Publishes guidelines, including PDFs, directly to a dedicated Notion database (no LLM processing).
- Avoids duplicate guideline entries using URL-based checks.
- Supports both manual and automated (cron) workflows.
- Integrated with the Security News Module for sequential processing of guidelines and news items.
